```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE
)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(stringr)
library(data.table)
library(patchwork)

```
This is used to set up the data with necessary variables. Can be copied into any markdown.
```{r}

patient_data2 <- read_csv("narratives.csv", locale = locale(encoding = "ISO-8859-1"))git
```

```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=8}
#patient call and transport volume is empty
patient_data2 <- patient_data2|>
  mutate(
    date = mdy_hms(`Incident Date Time`),
    `mm/yyyy` = format(date, "%m/%Y"),
    month = my(`mm/yyyy`),
    season = case_when(
      month(date) %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ (year(date) - 2021) * 4 + 1,
      month(date) %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ (year(date) - 2021) * 4 + 2,
      month(date) %in% c(6, 7, 8) ~ (year(date) - 2021) * 4 + 3,
      month(date) %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ (year(date) - 2021) * 4 + 4
    ),
    season_label = case_when(
      month(date) %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ paste("Winter", year(date)),
      month(date) %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ paste("Spring", year(date)),
      month(date) %in% c(6, 7, 8) ~ paste("Summer", year(date)),
      month(date) %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ paste("Fall", year(date))
    )
  )

#Mutating call duration features
#Dispatch -> back in service
#dispatch -> destination
patient_data2 <- patient_data2 |>
  mutate(
    total_event_duration = difftime( mdy_hms(`Incident Unit Back In Service Date Time (eTimes.13)`), mdy_hms(`Incident Unit Notified By Dispatch Date Time (eTimes.03)`), units = "mins"),
    dispatch_destination = difftime( mdy_hms(`Incident Patient Arrived At Destination Date Time (eTimes.11)`), mdy_hms(`Incident Unit Notified By Dispatch Date Time (eTimes.03)`), units = "mins")
  )|>
    mutate(ready = as.numeric(lubridate::hms(`Incident Patient Arrived At Destination To Unit Back In Service In HHMMSS`),
                            units = "mins"
    ))

patient_data2 <- patient_data2 |>
    mutate(unsched = case_when(
    `EMS Shift (itResponse.005)` == "No Shift (Second Call/Call-In Transfer)" ~ "Second Call",
    `EMS Shift (itResponse.005)` == "No Shift (Second Call)"  ~ "Second Call",
    (`Capability of Unit (eResponse.07)` == "Call Turn Over / Mutual Aid") & (`Response Type Of Service Requested With Code (eResponse.05)` != "Mutual Aid (2205009)")  ~
      "Turned Over",
    TRUE ~ "Scheduled"))

patient_data2 <- patient_data2 |>
  mutate(`EMS Shift (itResponse.005)` = case_when(
    `EMS Shift (itResponse.005)` == "A" ~ "911 Day",
    `EMS Shift (itResponse.005)` == "B" ~ "911 Night",
    `EMS Shift (itResponse.005)` == "Transfer Shift" ~ "Transfer Shift",
    `EMS Shift (itResponse.005)` == "911 Night" ~ "911 Night",
    `EMS Shift (itResponse.005)` == "911 Day" ~ "911 Day",
    `EMS Shift (itResponse.005)` == "No Shift (Second Call/Call-In Transfer)" ~ "No Shift (Second Call/Call-In Transfer)",
    `EMS Shift (itResponse.005)` == "Event/Standby" ~ "Event/Standby",
    `EMS Shift (itResponse.005)` == "No Shift (Second Call)" ~ "No Shift (Second Call)"
  ))
  
```
